      "evidence": "Carries the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and fixes an out-of-bounds read in the UniValue JSON tokenizer that processes RPC requests.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes out-of-bounds read vulnerabilities in the JSON tokenizer used across the node's RPC interface. As noted in the description, getJsonToken() assumed null-terminated input and could read past the end pointer on keywords or number prefixes."
    },

      "name": "tests",

      "rationale": "Non-member. Test updates pin the behavior of the UniValue parser and belong to that area rather than test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Touches the univalue subtree under src/univalue/lib/univalue_read.cpp, which is explicitly covered by the utilities category.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Resolves memory safety defects in the vendored UniValue parsing primitive. The description confirms it fixes #28260 where keyword and number parsing performed out-of-bounds reads beyond buffer end pointers."
